message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: defendant Luo forged four car purchase invoice copies using name of a convicted person (Qiao) as a credit proof, then obtained a loan of 300,000 yuan from a rural commercial bank. After loan due, repaid 20,000 and transferred loan 280,000 (i.e., rolled over). Then loan defaulted, causing direct economic loss of 280,000 to bank.

This is typical of "贷款诈骗" (loan fraud) or "诈骗罪" specifically loan fraud. Also includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" maybe? But the forged documents are private commercial invoices, not state documents. So crime is "诈骗罪" (fraud) specifically "贷款诈骗". In examples, they used "贷款诈骗" as a label for similar case (刘2某). So answer: [罪名]贷款诈骗<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" not applicable. So single crime.

Return JSON with reasoning and final answer.
